Sensitivity Converter

Convert sensitivity between games. Free, no sign-up, works in your browser on desktop and mobile.

Frequently asked questions

How is sensitivity converted between games?

By matching cm/360°, the physical mouse distance for a full turn, using each game’s yaw value and your DPI. It converts hipfire only; scoped sensitivity is not converted.

Why does my converted sensitivity feel slightly off?

Games round sensitivity and some apply acceleration or field-of-view scaling. Treat the result as a starting point and fine-tune in-game.
